operator.name: sipl_capture_op
operator.description: SIPL camera capture operator for Holoscan SDK 5.x — acquires frames from NvSIPL-managed cameras on Jetson/IGX platforms

changelog.0.1.0: Full NvSIPL pipeline port from hololink SIPLCaptureService; HSDK5 lifecycle hooks; DLManagedTensor emission; no HSB/hololink header dependency

required: NvSIPL dev packages (NvSIPLCamera.hpp) from JetPack / Isaac OS
